scope: Brand-independent crack assessment and concrete deterioration/spalling guidance. Manufacturer-specific repair products, dimensions and application values are excluded.

rules.claim: Cracking in masonry can have multiple causes, including foundation settlement, shrinkage, thermal or moisture movement, inadequate support, freeze-thaw effects, corrosion of embedded metal, differential movement between materials and salt expansion. Therefore a visible crack should not automatically be treated as a cosmetic filling problem without considering its cause and surrounding movement or deformation.
rules.customer_guidance_el: Μια ρωγμή στην τοιχοποιία δεν είναι πάντα απλώς αισθητικό πρόβλημα. Μπορεί να σχετίζεται με καθίζηση, συστολή, θερμικές ή υγρασιακές μετακινήσεις, ανεπαρκή στήριξη, διάβρωση μεταλλικών στοιχείων ή διαφορετική κίνηση μεταξύ υλικών. Πριν επιλεγεί υλικό γεμίσματος ή βαφή, πρέπει να αξιολογείται η αιτία και αν υπάρχουν ενδείξεις συνεχιζόμενης μετακίνησης ή παραμόρφωσης.
rules.stop_escalation: Escalate instead of prescribing cosmetic filling/coating when cracking is accompanied by bowing, leaning, displacement, recurring opening, widespread deterioration or other evidence suggesting movement or structural involvement.
rules.applicability_note: The source concerns brick masonry. The rule is used to prevent automatic cosmetic treatment of unexplained masonry cracking, not to diagnose a specific structural cause remotely.

rules.claim: Concrete spalling and delamination can result from distinct underlying mechanisms, including reinforcement corrosion, freeze-thaw action, reactive processes and overstress. A repair decision should therefore consider the cause and depth/extent of deterioration rather than simply covering the visible surface loss.
rules.customer_guidance_el: Αποφλοίωση, αποκόλληση ή αποσάθρωση σκυροδέματος μπορεί να έχει διαφορετικές αιτίες, όπως διάβρωση οπλισμού, κύκλους ψύξης-απόψυξης, αντιδράσεις μέσα στο σκυρόδεμα ή υπερκαταπόνηση. Η ορατή απώλεια υλικού δεν πρέπει απλώς να καλύπτεται: χρειάζεται αξιολόγηση της αιτίας και της έκτασης της βλάβης πριν επιλεγεί επισκευή ή τελική επίστρωση.
rules.stop_escalation: Escalate where concrete is delaminated, materially spalled, deterioration depth is uncertain, or reinforcement/prestressing steel is exposed or suspected to be involved.

rules.applicability_note: FHWA material is infrastructure-focused; only the general diagnostic principle that spalling/delamination can have different underlying mechanisms is generalized here. Pavement-specific repair dimensions and thresholds are not generalized to buildings.

rules.claim: Successful concrete repair requires identifying the extent of deteriorated or unsound concrete; the full extent may not be visible at the surface. Repairing only the visible surface without establishing sound substrate can leave deterioration behind and compromise the repair.
rules.customer_guidance_el: Σε επισκευή σκυροδέματος, η πραγματική έκταση της φθοράς μπορεί να είναι μεγαλύτερη από αυτή που φαίνεται στην επιφάνεια. Πριν από επισκευαστικό υλικό ή επίστρωση πρέπει να επιβεβαιώνεται ότι η βάση που παραμένει είναι σταθερή και υγιής και ότι δεν έχει μείνει κρυφή αποκόλληση ή σαθρό σκυρόδεμα.
rules.stop_escalation: If the extent/depth of unsound concrete cannot be established safely, or deterioration continues beyond a superficial repair zone, stop the DIY coating/patch recommendation and refer for competent assessment.

source.title: Partial-Depth Repairs — Construction: Finding Unsound Concrete

rules.applicability_note: The source is concrete pavement repair guidance. Numeric pavement repair boundaries, tool pressures and depth criteria are intentionally not generalized to building repairs.

rules.claim: Corrosion of reinforcing steel can generate expansive forces that crack, spall and debond surrounding concrete. Exposed reinforcement or spalling associated with suspected reinforcement corrosion is therefore not merely a surface-paint defect.
rules.customer_guidance_el: Η διάβρωση του οπλισμού μπορεί να δημιουργήσει δυνάμεις που ρηγματώνουν, αποκολλούν και αποσαθρώνουν το σκυρόδεμα γύρω του. Αν φαίνεται οπλισμός ή η αποκόλληση φαίνεται να σχετίζεται με σκουριά/διάβρωση, το πρόβλημα δεν πρέπει να αντιμετωπίζεται σαν απλή βαφή ή επιφανειακό στοκάρισμα.
rules.stop_escalation: Visible reinforcement, rust-related cracking/spalling, or suspected loss of concrete cover triggers specialist assessment before cosmetic coating selection.

unresolved.question: What universal crack-width threshold separates cosmetic repair from specialist/structural assessment?
unresolved.reason: No universal building threshold is established by the reviewed sources. Significance depends on substrate, movement, location, cause and structural context.

unresolved.question: How long should a crack be monitored before it can be considered inactive?
unresolved.reason: No universal monitoring duration is asserted; movement may be seasonal or condition-dependent.

unresolved.question: What depth/area of concrete spalling is safe for a customer-directed superficial repair?
unresolved.reason: Reviewed FHWA numerical thresholds are pavement-specific and must not be transferred to building concrete.

layer_boundary.note: No universal crack width, crack monitoring duration, repair depth, reinforcement treatment, patch material, primer, cure time, mixing ratio, layer thickness or coating compatibility is asserted here.
